evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's official Topsham Conservation Area Appraisal Appendix 3 search-indexed text identifies a 'Bridge Inn' sub-area (Bridge Hill to Elm Grove Road) and states that the conservation-area sub-areas have separate plans showing key features and building impacts. Direct retrieval of the official PDF URL returned HTTP 403 in the available web channel. Because the PDF payload could not be read, no record-level physical footprint polygon coordinates were extracted or inferred, and the area-level plan reference is not treated as parcel progress.

field_evidence.footprint: Indexed council text states separate plans show key features/building impacts for Topsham sub-areas, but the PDF payload returned HTTP 403; no polygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.location: The indexed official document defines the Bridge Inn sub-area as Bridge Hill to Elm Grove Road within Topsham Conservation Area.
field_evidence.type_use: The indexed official document names a distinct 'Bridge Inn' sub-area, providing explicit inn identity/use wording at area-plan level, not a record-bound building geometry.
